status: frozen after the independent official-state V19CZ retry retired the public Resolve-v1 regional NXB route and after source-only inspection of the already-spent V19M bin maps, broad-band region statistics and response-index metadata, but before opening any V19DA source or background PHA payload, response energy grid, line centroid, fitted temperature, abundance, redshift, published Abell 2146 velocity outcome, lensing or halo target, gravity formula or action
purpose: Measure a signed, spatially resolved line-of-sight ICM velocity field from Chandra Fe-K centroids as a possible continuous baryonic current/stress source for a later one-metric Sigma action. This protocol tests source observability only; it does not test, select or tune a gravity formula.
scientific_question: Does the baryonic ICM contain a reproducible time-odd spatial field, beyond density and fit noise, whose sign and direction transfer from the Bullet development system to Abell 2146 under one unchanged measurement rule?

evidence_design.BULLET: development-only reproduction; the published qualitative velocity result is known and cannot validate new physics
evidence_design.ABELL2146: internally target-sealed transfer; a 2016 paper applied the same broad method to this cluster, so it is explicitly not a pristine literature-blind holdout even though this project has not opened its numerical velocity outcome
evidence_design.claim_limit: A pass can admit a Chandra-resolvable signed source candidate for covariant derivation. It cannot validate Sigma Gravity, establish a halo replacement, or substitute for a future genuinely prospective cluster.

metadata_contract.payload_access_during_preflight: forbidden; names, byte lengths and parent hashes only

BULLET.galactic_nh_role: measured absorption nuisance, not a gravity parameter
BULLET.primary_observation_reason: match the nine VFAINT observations in the published development method
BULLET.observation_robustness_reason: add the already-processed FAINT ObsID 554 without pretending VFAINT cleaning exists

ABELL2146.galactic_nh_role: measured absorption nuisance, not a gravity parameter
ABELL2146.primary_observation_reason: match the eight VFAINT observations disclosed in the published transfer-era method
ABELL2146.observation_robustness_reason: include every already-frozen and calibrated V19F observation

regionization.source_information_allowed: only the frozen V19M 0.5-7.0 keV bin map, admission flag, broad science counts, scaled broad background counts, net counts and pixel adjacency
forbidden_region_information: hardness ratio or any energy-resolved source count
shock, member, lensing, halo or gravity map
regionization.adjacency: four-neighbor shared pixel edges on the frozen integer bin map
regionization.merge_order: repeatedly select the active connected component with the lowest net count below target; merge it with the adjacent component having the largest shared boundary, then the closest mean net-count surface brightness, then the smallest deterministic root bin ID
regionization.claim_boundary: These expected counts were learned from source-only brightness and adjacency during method development. No spectral or gravitational outcome entered them.

combination.source_and_background: combine every validated cell named by a frozen merged region, first within ObsID and then across ObsIDs using the already-commissioned V19CW observation hierarchy and ASCA background scaling
combination.responses: combine ARFs and RMFs with the same exposure/backscale weighting commissioned in V19CW; never average model predictions after fitting independent cells
combination.source_spectrum: retain an ungrouped combined source PHA for WStat/Cash-family fitting; a grouped copy may be made for visualization only
combination.count_conservation: full PHA source counts must equal the sum over contributing cell PHAs exactly, separately for every region and observation branch
combination.response_forward_fold_gate: the hierarchical response must reproduce a direct reference forward-fold to relative tolerance 1e-8 on manufactured/reference apertures before development fitting

spectral_model.atomic_database: the APEC database delivered with CIAO 4.18 / XSPEC 12.14.0k, recorded verbatim at runtime
spectral_model.redshift_coupling: the two thermal components share exactly one redshift
free_parameters_primary: Galactic nH within its nuisance interval
spectral_model.temperature_order: enforce T1 <= T2 to remove label exchange
spectral_model.statistic: WStat on ungrouped source and associated blank-sky background counts
spectral_model.optimizer: Nelder-Mead multistart followed by Levenberg-Marquardt/covariance only where locally regular
spectral_model.fit_quality: 500 parametric posterior-predictive simulations per integrated spectrum and 200 per region; fail a model branch when the fraction with a lower statistic is outside [0.02,0.98]

redshift_profile.profile_rule: at every fixed redshift refit every other free parameter; choose the global profile minimum
redshift_profile.statistical_interval: asymmetric Delta-statistic=1 crossings around the global minimum
redshift_profile.secondary_minimum_gate: reject a region when another local minimum is separated from the best by Delta-statistic < 6.63
redshift_profile.edge_gate: reject a region when the best fit or either Delta-statistic=1 crossing reaches the frozen search boundary
redshift_profile.velocity_definition: v_los = c*(z_region-z_cluster)/(1+z_cluster); z_cluster is the inverse-total-variance common-redshift estimate within the same branch

thermal_structure_systematic.purpose: propagate the shift of the unresolved Fe-K blend caused by unknown line-of-sight temperature and abundance mixtures
thermal_structure_systematic.sampler: 4096-point Owen-scrambled Sobol sequence in ordered T1,T2,Z1,Z2 over the frozen bounds, with seed 1900416 for every region; common points prevent outcome-dependent sampling
thermal_structure_systematic.full_band_admission: at fixed T1,T2,Z1,Z2, optimize non-negative norms, nH and redshift in 0.5-10 keV; retain points with Delta-statistic < 4.72 relative to the full-band optimum
thermal_structure_systematic.hard_band_projection: for every retained point, refit norms and redshift in 2-10 keV using the frozen global-profile search
thermal_structure_systematic.systematic_interval: 5th and 95th percentiles of the retained hard-band redshift minima
thermal_structure_systematic.convergence_audit: repeat every fifth spatial region and every integrated spectrum with 8192 points; both systematic endpoints must change by less than 10 percent of the primary interval width
thermal_structure_systematic.total_uncertainty: add the asymmetric statistical, thermal-structure and propagated gain terms in quadrature on each side

gain_audit.data: per-ObsID union of the already-matched blank-sky background cells, constructed without a source spectrum
gain_audit.model: local continuum plus Gaussian lines with a per-ObsID linear gain E_cal = intercept + slope*E_recorded
gain_audit.primary_use: do not post-hoc shift the source spectrum; propagate the fitted intercept/slope covariance to the observed Fe-K energy as an additional redshift systematic
gain_audit.robustness_use: repeat with the fitted linear gain applied and require stable velocity sign topology
gain_audit.gate: the propagated one-sigma gain uncertainty at observed Fe-K must be <= 0.2 times the median pre-gain total redshift uncertainty in each cluster; otherwise the cluster source is not admitted

reliability_gates.no_outcome_based_region_removal: a region can fail only the frozen secondary-minimum, edge, finite-interval, fit-goodness or uncertainty gates; every failure remains in the report

required_before_transfer: all combination, response and gain preflights pass
at least 12 primary and 10 robustness regions are reliable
the common-redshift null has p <= 0.10 in the primary APEC branch
at least one pairwise region contrast excludes zero at 3 sigma after the familywise max-contrast calibration
at least 75 percent of reliable regions retain velocity sign across APEC versus MEKAL, 8000 versus 10000 counts, nine versus ten observations, and gain-propagated versus gain-corrected branches
development_reproduction_gate.interpretation: reproduction validates the measurement implementation only because the published Bullet outcome is known

transfer_and_source_admission_gate.target_access: forbidden until the complete Bullet development report, code and configuration are hashed and every development reproduction gate passes
required_for_time_odd_source_admission: at least 12 primary and 10 robustness regions are reliable
the spatially constant-redshift null is rejected at p <= 0.05 or a familywise-calibrated localized contrast excludes zero at 3 sigma
at least 75 percent of reliable regions retain velocity sign across APEC versus MEKAL, 8000 versus 10000 counts, eight versus ten observations, and gain-propagated versus gain-corrected branches

the cross-validated spatial velocity field explains at least 20 percent variance beyond a fixed quadratic nuisance basis of gas surface density, radius, density gradient and density Hessian invariants
leave-one-region-out and leave-one-ObsID-out reruns retain the admitted sign topology in at least 90 percent of omissions
transfer_and_source_admission_gate.if_pass: admit signed line-of-sight gas current as an observed source candidate and freeze its covariant placement tests before opening any lensing target
transfer_and_source_admission_gate.if_fail: do not use Chandra redshift noise as a Sigma source; retain the result and seek a prospective calorimeter, resolved kSZ or newly released region-aware likelihood rather than changing thresholds

forbidden_access_until_authorized: any V19DA PHA CHANNEL, COUNTS or energy-resolved row
any V19DA ARF/RMF energy or response array
any fitted Bullet or Abell 2146 temperature, abundance, redshift or velocity
the published numerical Abell 2146 velocity result or map
any cluster lensing image, shear, convergence, halo map or halo fit
any gravity formula score, action selection or gravity parameter optimization

runtime.reason: XSPEC/Sherpa model evaluation is CPU-bound; region-level process parallelism avoids unsafe shared model state

implementation.future_combiner: not yet authorized until this preflight passes and is committed
implementation.future_fitter: not yet authorized until the combiner passes manufactured and exact-count tests
